title: Curated 25-entry creative production services page scan — exploratory lexical source inventory
research_question: What information is publicly present on purposefully chosen commercial moving-image, AI VFX, CGI or adjacent creative-tech provider entry pages?
sample_design: Deliberately selected candidates from search results and prior examples; service pages, case articles and homepages are mixed. NOT RANDOM, NOT A MARKET CENSUS. No organization inference from missing data.
population: 25 unique provider URLs excluding own objekts control
measurement: TinyFish page text as retrieved. Four regex term families count English literal tokens, including false positives, and may miss synonyms, other languages, javascript-only pages, links, or forms; these counts alone do NOT establish proof quality, validated cases, consent routes or agent discovery.

term_patterns.enquiry: \b(contact us|tell us about|let.s talk|request a quote|send a brief|start a project|get in touch|book a call|book your project|discuss a project|start a project)\b
